title: acer hyrcanum subsp. tauricola
intro: Acer hyrcanum subsp. tauricola, commonly known as the Taurus Maple, is a subspecies of maple tree that belongs to the Sapindaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its health benefits in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Acer hyrcanum subsp. tauricola are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal activities.
